title: Trace radicals and cocenters of free products
summary: We call a unital associative algebra $A$ trace residually finite-dimensional if its elements are separated by finite-dimensional representations and its cocenter $A/[A,A]$ is separated by the corresponding trace functionals. For RFD algebras $A$ and $B$, we prove that the trace radical of $A*B$, the common kernel of all finite-dimensional trace functionals, is the direct sum of the trace radicals of $A$ and $B$, which implies that $A*B$ is trace RFD if and only if both $A$ and $B$ are trace RFD.
